title: A recipe becomes a cooking short
pitch: Three moments of a recipe in. Three moving overhead shots and a light score out, with no hands in frame.
why: Overhead food shots are the clearest test of steam, bubbles and shine. Z-Image draws each step from the same angle, Wan 2.2 makes it move, and ACE-Step scores it.

models.name: ffmpeg
models.licence: LGPL/GPL, runs as a separate tool

tips: Keep the same angle and board in every step so the cut feels like one kitchen.

57:27.text: Overhead photograph of ripe red tomatoes, garlic and fresh basil on a worn wooden chopping board, a chef's knife beside them, soft window light, no people, no hands.
Overhead photograph of a wide black pan of tomato sauce simmering with basil leaves on a wooden board beside a gas hob, gentle steam, soft window light, no people, no hands.
Overhead photograph of a white plate of spaghetti with tomato sauce and fresh basil on a worn wooden table, a little steam rising, soft window light, no people, no hands.

steps.label: Shot 1
steps.prompt: Soft window light shifts slightly across the tomatoes and basil, a basil leaf moves a little in a breeze. The camera stays still overhead.

steps.label: Shot 2
steps.prompt: The tomato sauce bubbles gently in the pan and steam rises and drifts. The camera stays still overhead.

steps.label: Shot 3
steps.prompt: Steam rises slowly from the hot spaghetti, the sauce glistens. The camera stays still overhead.

94.tags: Light acoustic guitar and soft hand percussion, warm and cheerful, kitchen morning, no vocals

steps.label: Three shots
steps.does: The shots in order with soft dissolves.

steps.label: Picture and score
steps.does: Lays the score under the cut.
